name: everest
purpose: s064 the paper climber on Everest's summit (real snow); the same-scale comparisons stay on BlockStage (lab/hawaii/data/everest_h16.png).
gaps: Terrarium z14 (SRTM 30 m): summit 8,748 m on the grid vs 8,849 m surveyed (the same-scale comparisons stay on BlockStage, which scales to 8,849 m). HLS 30 m, November 2023 snow.

Colour (round 3, 2026-11-09): HLS 30 m from the pre-monsoon high-sun window (10 April-10 June 2022-2024, the 6 clearest days, median): near-black texels 3.3 % to 0.09 %, on north faces 6.1 % to 0.07 % (was October-December, low sun). The monsoon months are cloud-covered and the HLS Fmask calls the high snowfields cloud (half the pixels above 6,500 m never clear), so they are not used. Light from the south still reads best (preset everest); AO tangent.
